s: Kong, Traefik, Istio, rate limiting, auth, routing, observability
d: API Gateways sit in front of your services handling cross-cutting concerns: authentication, rate limiting, request routing, and monitoring. Service meshes handle service-to-service communication with mTLS, retries, and circuit breaking.

p: Api Gateway is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.
1. Understand the core principles and trade-offs.
2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
